name: set_speed
description: Set the speed of the car the user drives, in km/h. 0 stops the car.

name: set_wipers
description: Set the windscreen wipers of the car the user drives.

name: honk
description: Sound the horn of the car the user drives. At most 5 times.

name: park
description: Park the car in the next free bay on the right. Returns when it has stopped.

name: get_sign_photo
description: Get the car's last photo of a parking sign. Use it when the user asks about parking here and no photo is attached.
